messages:

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form: template fit review and signer routing

Irene / Jonas —

Looping you in on a new inbound from ClearWave (Emma). They signed a commercial LOI and we need a quick template-fit review and signer routing checklist so Sales can lock the timeline. Attached: MSA_Redline_Template.docx and the initial OrderForm_v1.pdf from the buyer.

High level asks from Sales / Customer:
- Confirm whether our standard MSA fits ClearWave's commercial and residency needs or if we should expect material redlines (liability, data residency, termination for convenience).
- Identify required party details to fill Exhibit A and the signer path (ClearWave says the legal signer is a VP Legal but CFO prefers PO-based billing).
- Any immediate blocking legal flags to surface to Sales (e.g., export/residency carveouts).

Target timeline: Sales needs a prioritized list of redlines + recommended owner for each item by EOD tomorrow (Aug 2). This is a small deal but they want the first-pass to be quick.

Attachments: OrderForm_v1.pdf (pdf stub), MSA_Redline_Template.docx (docx stub).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>; Emma Li <emma.li@clearwave.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: template fit review and signer routing

Thanks, Kim. Emma — nice to meet you.

Quick read through the docs I opened these flags up front so Sales can triage:
1) Data residency / Exhibit B: If ClearWave requires EU/region-specific residency, that is a material ops ask. We need to know the residency preference and whether any data classification (PII/PHI) applies.
2) Liability & indemnity: We'll check if the Order Form drives a higher revenue-based cap; if so we may propose a commercial cap swap.
3) Billing flow: PO-based billing vs. our standard invoice cadence — if they require PO before signature, Ops needs to know now.

Please confirm the following so our first pass is productive:
- Full legal entity legal name and jurisdiction (for Exhibit A).
- Who the commercial vs legal signers are (name, title, email).
- Any residency or hosting constraints (e.g., EU-only, on-prem, VPC).
- If a SOC2/Security questionnaire is expected during contracting.

I can do an initial redline prioritization and flag the top three items by EOD tomorrow. Jonas, please bookmark IP/ownership language for a quick look — historically ClearWave-type buyers ask for custom data-ownership language.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
irene.choi@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

---
Note: attaching our internal intake checklist in follow-up once we have the party sheet.

Thanks, Irene / Kimberly — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attaching the party sheet and a scanned signer attestation. Notes below:

Attachments: ClearWave_Party_Sheet.xlsx, Party_Signer_Attestation.pdf, OrderForm_v1.pdf (updated)

- Legal entity: ClearWave Systems, Inc. (Delaware)
- Primary legal signer: Dana Morris, VP Legal — dana.morris@clearwave.com (will sign via DocuSign)
- Commercial sign-off / billing: Mike Tran, VP Finance — prefers a PO process; open to invoice cadence if needed (mike.tran@clearwave.com)
- Data residency: Production data must remain in the US; no EU-only residency needed. We do host some EU PII for EU customers but for this integration the data will be US-resident.
- Security: We have a short security packet and can share SOC2 report on request; SOC2 available but not required pre-signature.

We pushed the updated OrderForm_v1.pdf that reflects projected seat counts and the requested add-on. Happy to hop on a 20-minute sync if it helps.

—Emma

Internal summary and next steps (per Sales ask):

Top priority redlines to surface (first pass):
- Liability cap: Recommend we keep standard cap but offer $X commercial cap in alternative if they push. Owner: Jonas Weber (commercial counsel).
- Data residency / Exhibit B: Customer confirms US-only for this integration. Low operational impact, but include explicit Exhibit B language stating US residency for production data. Owner: Irene Choi.
- Billing / PO preference: Ops needs to confirm we can accept PO pre-signature or accept PO post-signature with invoice cadence. Owner: Kimberly Park to coordinate with Rev Ops.
- IP & derivatives: Jonas to check language in Section 4 and propose clean fallback if they request custom derivations.

Action items: 
- Jonas: draft liability-cap alternative language and quick rationale (due: 2027-08-02T17:00:00-07:00).
- Kimberly: confirm PO flow with Rev Ops and whether Accounting needs any clause edits (due: EOD 2027-08-02).
- Irene: produce prioritized single-page redline document (MSA_Redline_Template annotated) and a recommended signatory routing note for Sales (due: 2027-08-02T17:00:00-07:00).

I'll attach the annotated intake checklist when complete. For now, funnel any security evidence requests to security-evidence@redwood.ai.
